caption: The rendered preview of a handbook: table of contents, a note, the release checklist table and a tip.
eval: (async () => { const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); app.plugins.plugins['asciidoc-files'].pro.signOut(); await sleep(600); const v = app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf().view; v.setMode('preview'); v.previewEl.scrollTop = 0; await sleep(300); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Source and preview side by side: highlighted titles, attributes, blocks and macros on the left.
eval: (async () => { const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const v = app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf().view; v.setMode('split'); await sleep(500); v.previewEl.scrollTop = 0; return 'ok'; })()

caption: The free preview shows a Mermaid flowchart and a sequence diagram.
eval: (async () => { app.workspace.rightSplit.collapse(); const p = app.plugins.plugins['asciidoc-files']; p.pro.signOut(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 700)); const v = app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf().view; v.setMode('preview'); await v.render(); v.previewEl.querySelectorAll('.adoc-mermaid button').forEach((b) => { if (b.textContent === 'Allow') b.click(); }); for (let i = 0; i < 100 && v.previewEl.querySelectorAll('.adoc-mermaid svg[aria-roledescription]').length !== 2; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); if (v.previewEl.querySelectorAll('.adoc-mermaid svg[aria-roledescription]').length !== 2) throw new Error('Expected two Mermaid diagrams'); v.previewEl.scrollTop = 0; return 'ok'; })()

caption: A click on the exit codes cross reference opens the command reference at that section.
eval: (async () => { const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const v = app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf().view; v.setMode('preview'); await sleep(300); v.previewEl.querySelector('a[href="Reference.adoc#exit-codes"]').click(); await sleep(900); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Pro: the install and configure chapters and the tagged part of the deploy script come in through include directives.
eval: (async () => { const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const p = app.plugins.plugins['asciidoc-files']; p.pro.opts.http = async () => ({ status: 200, json: { data: { viewer: { login: 'demo-reader' }, user: { sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor: { isActive: true, isOneTimePayment: false, tier: { name: '$5 a month', monthlyPriceInCents: 500 } } } } } }); app.secretStorage.setSecret('asciidoc-files-github-token', 'gho_' + '0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow(); await sleep(900); await sleep(300); const v = app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf().view; v.setMode('preview'); await v.render(); await sleep(500); const h = [...v.previewEl.querySelectorAll('h2')].find((x) => x.textContent === 'Configure a project'); if (h) v.previewEl.scrollTop = h.offsetTop - 20; return 'ok'; })()

caption: Pro: the outline and links panel lists sections, includes, cross references (one missing) and the files that link here.
eval: (async () => { const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const p = app.plugins.plugins['asciidoc-files']; p.pro.opts.http = async () => ({ status: 200, json: { data: { viewer: { login: 'demo-reader' }, user: { sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor: { isActive: true, isOneTimePayment: false, tier: { name: '$5 a month', monthlyPriceInCents: 500 } } } } } }); app.secretStorage.setSecret('asciidoc-files-github-token', 'gho_' + '0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow(); await sleep(900); await app.plugins.plugins['asciidoc-files'].openLinksPanel(); await sleep(1200); return 'ok'; })()

caption: Pro: Export the current file to HTML writes Handbook.html next to the source.
eval: (async () => { const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const p = app.plugins.plugins['asciidoc-files']; p.pro.opts.http = async () => ({ status: 200, json: { data: { viewer: { login: 'demo-reader' }, user: { sponsorshipForViewerAsSponsor: { isActive: true, isOneTimePayment: false, tier: { name: '$5 a month', monthlyPriceInCents: 500 } } } } } }); app.secretStorage.setSecret('asciidoc-files-github-token', 'gho_' + '0'.repeat(36)); await p.pro.refreshNow(); await sleep(900); const v = app.workspace.getMostRecentLeaf().view; app.vault.setConfig('showUnsupportedFiles', true); const path = await app.plugins.plugins['asciidoc-files'].exportHtml(v); await sleep(400); const fe = app.workspace.getLeavesOfType('file-explorer')[0]; const f = app.vault.getFileByPath(path); if (fe && f) await app.workspace.revealLeaf(fe); await sleep(600); return 'ok'; })()
after: (async () => { const f = app.vault.getFileByPath('AsciiDoc Files/Handbook.html'); if (f) await app.vault.delete(f); app.plugins.plugins['asciidoc-files'].pro.signOut(); return 'ok'; })()
